item.title: Downed tree blocking the stepped stile before crossing the road., 8th November
item.description:
It's in the field as you approach the golden heart pub heading south towards the main B road carriageway. The tree has fallen in the gap between the stepped stile and the carriageway meaning it's very hard to get over. As we had to climb over and duck under the tree avoiding the nettles and thorns. Believe it is at these co ordinates, once there the tree is very visible to see: 51.822285,-2.083778.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Ermine Way, Birdlip, Cotswold

item.title: Very poor quality repair to dropped pavement, 8th November
item.description:

The repair is of very poor quality and 2 weeks later it is coming apart and scattering tarmac stones across the road. A gentle brush of the area was able to remove large quantities of the stones as per the image.
